name: Retro Synthwave Grid Floor
description: An infinitely scrolling Tron/vaporwave floor grid that recedes to a glowing horizon, built entirely from layered gradients and a single 3D transform with no canvas or JavaScript.
usage: Drop the .rgf markup (sky, sun, plane, grid) into a sized container and include styles.css; the grid fills its parent and scrolls forever. Override the --rgf-* custom properties to retune line color, glow, cell size, speed, tilt, and perspective.
